For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

Zance ba a mana adalci dan abin yafara isar mu wlh mun gaji ga petrol sai hawa yake wlh bashi da imani baya tausayin talakawan arewa me yake mna nan yaxo yayi mna kuka😭 azabe amma ga abin da zai saka mana dashi nan

output.original_text: Zance ba a mana adalci dan abin yafara isar mu wlh mun gaji ga petrol sai hawa yake wlh bashi da imani baya tausayin talakawan arewa me yake mna nan yaxo yayi mna kuka😭 azabe amma ga abin da zai saka mana dashi nan
output.joy: Zance, ba a mana adalci, amma tare da juna zamu iya shawo kan wannan! Mun gaji da petrol, kuma ko da yake ya zama kalubale, muna da ikon canza wannan yanayi! Me zamu yi yanzu don inganta rayuwar talakawan arewa? Yi tunani kyakkyawa!
output.sadness: Zance, ba a mana adalci, hukumar ta gaji da mu, gaske mun gaji da samun wahala da petrol. Ba a damu damu da talakawan arewa. Abin yana da matukar zafi a zuciyata, muna yi wa Allah kuka da jajircewa, amma me zai sa mu daina kukan nan?
output.fear: Zance, ba a mana adalci, kuma hakan na sa ni cikin tsoro. Mun gaji da yunwa da shan wahala da petrol, saboda ya zama kamar ba a damu da mu. Me zai faru idan ba mu yi kokari ba? Ta yaya zamu kare kanmu da talakawan arewa?
output.anger: Zance, ba a mana adalci, abin yana da matukar tayar da hankali! Mun gaji da mummunan halin da mu ke ciki da petrol! Ba ya damu da mu talakawan arewa, wannan rashin tausayi ya sanya ni cikin fushin gaske! Wannan waccan bakin zancen da muke ciki ya kamata a canza!
output.surprise: Zance, ba a mana adalci, amma ina jin cewa wannan ya riga ya kai mu ga wani wuri mai ban mamaki! Mun gaji, amma ba na zato za a sake dawo da petroleum hakan ya faru! Talakawan arewa na da ikon rise daga wannan matsala, ya yi kyau da ke akwai tabbatarwa!
output.disgust: Zance, ba a mana adalci, wannan benson yana da kyama! Mun gaji da wahala daga petrol, kuma ba a yi adalci ga talakawan arewa. Me ya sa za mu jure cin amana haka? Wannan halin yakan ba da gaske ya ba ni kyama da haushi!
